findings.title: Differentiate target-specific AIO mapping rationales in GloVe.yaml and remove candidate-proposal / batch-discovery diary text from MarkovRandomField, CLARANSClustering, LargeMarginNearestNeighbor, and RelevantComponentAnalysis

findings.disposition: Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology (src/ontology/aio-src.csv); generated data/aio/*.yaml files must remain exact projections of the pinned AIO release (AGENTS.md).
findings.summary: Pinned upstream AIO release 2026-07-22 (sources/aio/aio.json) contains three pairs of distinct class IRIs with overlapping definitions, parent chains, or cross-linked synonyms: (1) AIO:AddLayer (branches: [Layer], parents: [AIO:MergingLayer], definition: 'A merging layer that adds a list of inputs taking as input a list of tensors all of the same shape.') and AIO:AdditionLayer (branches: [Layer], parents: [AIO:Layer], definition: 'A layer that adds inputs from one or more other layers to cells or neurons of a target layer.'); (2) AIO:TransformerLLM (branches: [Model], parents: [AIO:TransformerLanguageModel], exact synonym 'Transformer Large Language Model') and AIO:TransformerLanguageModel (branches: [Model], parents: [AIO:LanguageModel], exact synonym 'Transformer LM'), whose definitions share the identical relative clause 'that uses the transformer architecture based on multi-head attention mechanisms allowing it to contextualize tokens within a context window for effective language understanding and generation'; and (3) AIO:ZeroShotLearningLLM (branches: [Model], parents: [AIO:LargeLanguageModel], exact synonym 'Zero-Shot LLM', related synonym 'zero-shot learning') and AIO:ZeroshotLearning (branches: [Network], parents: [AIO:DeepNeuralNetwork], exact synonym 'ZSL'). Because data/aio/*.yaml is generated and upstream identifiers must not be locally rewritten or merged without upstream curation, these boundary overlaps are deferred to berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology.
findings.title: Defer three upstream AIO near-duplicate class pairs (AddLayer/AdditionLayer, TransformerLLM/TransformerLanguageModel, ZeroShotLearningLLM/ZeroshotLearning) to upstream ontology curation

findings.disposition: Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology (src/ontology/aio-src.csv); maintained curated records already document these upstream placement caveats in aio_mappings[].rationale and identity_notes without mutating generated data/aio/*.yaml.
findings.summary: In pinned upstream AIO release 2026-07-22 (sources/aio/aio.json), AIO:RepresentationLearning (branches: [Network], parents: [AIO:DeepNeuralNetwork], definition: 'A deep neural network that discovers representations required for feature detection or classification from raw data.') and AIO:ZeroshotLearning (branches: [Network], parents: [AIO:DeepNeuralNetwork], definition: 'A deep neural network that predicts classes at test time from classes not observed during training.') are placed under AIO:DeepNeuralNetwork with definitions beginning 'A deep neural network that...' despite denoting learning paradigms/tasks, and top-level branch AIO:TrainingStrategy (branches: [TrainingStrategy], parents: [owl:Thing]) defines itself with the genus 'A preprocessing used to train machine learning models...' while AIO:Preprocessing is a sibling top-level branch. Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology because data/aio/*.yaml is generated from the pinned ontology snapshot.
findings.title: Defer upstream AIO genus-to-hierarchy mismatches on RepresentationLearning, ZeroshotLearning, and TrainingStrategy to upstream ontology curation

Deferred to upstream berkeleybop/artificial-intelligence-ontology because data/aio/*.yaml is generated and must reproduce sources/aio/aio.json byte-for-byte under python -m aimech seed --check.
findings.title: Defer upstream AIO exact-synonym typo ('Multilayer Perceptoron') on AIO:DeepFeedForwardNetwork to upstream ontology curation
